subject.size_in_frame: her own body seen end-on down its length: bodice and pinafore filling the near frame, waist, skirt and then her boots tiny at the far end, about 0.07 of frame height

second_subject.note: the same black ankle-strap boots that kicked once and vanished under the hedge in sh015 — far below on the flagstones, and identifiable.

headroom: not applicable: the axis is vertical, looking straight down her own body, so there is no tile equivalent and no horizon. The frame's 'top' is her own chest.
horizon_eyeline: None. The only spatial reference is the flagstone pattern at the far bottom of frame, and it is small enough to be a gauge in itself. Her eyeline is the lens.

layers.fg: her bodice and pinafore, enormous, filling the upper half of frame
layers.mg: the fall of her skirt running away down the frame and narrowing hard
layers.bg: the flagstones and her boots, almost out of sight far below

gaze.note: the shot is her look. The lead room is the entire length of her own body, and what is at the end of it is her feet, waving goodbye.

balance: A single steep funnel on the vertical centre line: near mass at the top, vanishing point at the bottom. Symmetrical and absurd.
leading_lines: The two edges of her own skirt converge from the frame edges down to her boots — her body is the perspective. The flagstone joints at the bottom give the funnel a floor.
eye_first: Straight down the funnel to the boots, because they are the smallest and brightest-edged thing in the frame.
constraint_binding: Played absolutely straight — the one piece of pure comedy in the dream half, so no comic angle, no wide-angle distortion of her face and no cutaway. The boots are the SAME black ankle-strap boots that kicked once and vanished in sh015, and they must be legible as such: they are kept sharp (deep focus, size beat) and unobstructed at the bottom of frame. The second and last of the two rationed 24 mm shots; its partner is sh052.
